name: randomised greedy construction then local improvement
mechanism: build a solution by repeatedly choosing at random among the few best-scoring next elements, then improve it by local moves, and repeat from scratch keeping the best

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Greedy randomized adaptive search procedure (GRASP)' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: successive constructions of a greedy randomized solution and subsequent iterative improvements of it through a local search

requires: a greedy scoring of next elements
fails_when: independent restarts learn nothing across rounds
